packageRules.description: Widen version ranges for pep621 packages rather than replacing them, preserving backward compatibility with older installed versions

Runtime-critical packages whose bumps touch the GUI event loop, HTTP client, or pydantic models — regressions in these only surface end-to-end (closure lifecycles, event handler exception swallowing, request retry semantics, ...). Override the global labels to drop `skip:test:long_running` so the long-running e2e matrix runs and catches integration regressions on every bump. Discovered while shipping nicegui 3.10/3.11 (#531) where a silently-swallowed AssertionError inside an async click handler hung a download dialog and was only caught by the long-running suite.
